definitions.gloss: to return home, to go back
definitions.explanation: To go back to one's home, country, or original location. The destination is typically a place one belongs to or comes from.

examples.english: What time do you go home?

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧、⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰|かえ}ります。
examples.english: I will return to my country next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{帰|かえ}りたい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I want to go home now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{帰|かえ}ります。
examples.english: I'll go home right after work ends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくなった→無くなる：01101_nakunaru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{帰|かえ}りました。
examples.english: The trains had stopped, so I went home by taxi.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰|かえ}る (return to X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {帰|かえ}っている = 'has returned (and is there now).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰|かえ}る (go home)
・⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{帰|かえ}る (return to one's country)
・お{帰|かえ}りなさい (welcome home - greeting)
・{帰|かえ}り (return trip - noun)

Godan verb despite ending in る. Different from ⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧ (return to previous state) and ⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ (to change - ichidan).
